entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Well, my mother finally talked to me...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: She told me that... most of my matches[n]thus far had been fixed in my favor...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: She also admitted that she was[n]the one who sold that story to[n]the weekly magazine...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I... I had no idea. I feel so ashamed...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: However, thinking back, I do[n]recall some of my opponents[n]making poor moves at odd times...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I've always wanted people to[n]recognize my shogi skills...[n]but I suppose I never had any.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I became so conceited as a result of[n]all those fake victories...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Why did my mother confess[n]all of a sudden?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It's as if she had a change of heart...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: A change of heart...[n]The Phantom Thieves!?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...That can't be.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Perhaps they eavesdropped[n]on our conversation?
Maybe...
You're overthinking it.
I'm glad her heart changed.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Huh? If that's the case, then...[n]I must applaud them. Well done,[n]Phantom Thieves.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: But I simply can't believe it...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: You're right...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It all just seems so surreal...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Yes.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: It was painful to hear the truth,[n]but I'm glad that my mother had[n]a change of heart.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I've decided...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I'm not going to lose.
Lose what?
What're you talking about?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Oh, sorry! I was referring to the [n]exhibition match... I'm going[n]through with it, as planned.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...However, before that, I'm[n]going to confess everything.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I know I'll receive a lot of criticism...[n]but I must ensure the truth is known.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: This next match will showcase my true talents.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I don't know how it's going to[n]go... but I hope you'll watch.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: As your teacher, I promise to put up[n]a good fight so I don't embarrass myself.
I feel Hifumi's trust in me growing...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I would be lying if I told you[n]that I'm not scared.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: My kingdom is a house of cards... I'm[n]not sure if it can withstand a true battle.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: However, I intend to fight with dignity[n]to the very end, as a queen should.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: There's a new move I'd like to[n]test out for the exhibition...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Will you stay for another game?

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Please come at me with all you have...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: That is, if you can get past the valiant[n]knights who guard my Togo Kingdom!

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: ...I see, so there's still room for[n]improvement. I'd like to do[n]this again some time.
